issue: Generated editable-install egg-info metadata was included in executable code hashing, so a reinstall could change the hash without any scientific source change.
resolution: Exclude generated .egg-info alongside __pycache__ and pyc. Model parameters, training numerics, configurations, thresholds, datasets and prompts are unchanged.
regression: tests/test_source_portability.py: metadata additions/changes preserve hash; an actual model-source edit changes it.
old_hashes: Older run records retain their originally measured hash and original source snapshots. Training workers started earlier may use the earlier logging hash algorithm; the final freeze/evaluator and separately extracted package use the corrected algorithm. This is a logging portability amendment, not model reselection.
